cohort: 46 women who underwent laparoscopic (n=13) or hysteroscopic (n=33) surgery for PCSD
finding: Both laparoscopic and hysteroscopic surgery are safe and effective treatments for PCSD patients, with hysteroscopic surgery being more efficient.
mod_finding: The study found that 9 out of 11 patients who underwent hysteroscopic surgery for PCSD had successful subsequent deliveries, with 2 experiencing placenta previa, while 2 out of 4 patients who underwent laparoscopic surgery had successful deliveries, with all 2 experiencing placenta previa.
